text:
elaine: Quick follow-up from the DR postmortem — we promised a clear owners+dates tracker before the next game day. I started a quick list, can people claim items or propose alternate owners? High priority: multi-region routing flakiness, cross-region snapshot retention, restore runbook dry-run, and detection telemetry gaps.

manu: I can take the routing test plan. I'll sketch a canary flow for regional cutover and add detailed success criteria. target: 2 weeks. @elaine FYI. :thumbsup:

zach: I'll own backups/retention. Need to confirm snapshot lifecycle across eu-west and us-west. Propose retention policy: 30 daily, 12 weekly, 6 monthly by default — will file recommended policy.

sophie: I'll run the first restore dry-run with platform infra — want to do a non-prod run next Wed. Need a rehearsal checklist.

oncall: re telemetry — we've seen three similar detection delays in last 6 months (latency spikes -> not routing). I'll pull logs and send patterns, and propose two alert thresholds.

kevin: @manu for routing: can you include automated failover gating (traffic-smoothing + KV cache warmup)? We hit cold-cache penalties last game day.

manu: yes — plan includes prefix cache warmup and a short ramp (10% -> 50% -> 100%) with health checks. I'll post a snippet.

incident-bot: NOTE: New tracker created: https://redwood.internal/dr-trackers/DR-2026-04-01 (please update with owner + due)

elaine: thanks. To keep this compact, please update the tracker and paste the tracker ID here once you claim an item. I'll consolidate into the game-day runbook. Also: call out any blockers (access, quotas, AWS org perms).

zach: DR-2026-04-01: DR-105 assigned to @zach, due 2026-04-18 — snapshot lifecycle proposal posted.

sophie: DR-2026-04-01: DR-106 assigned to @sophie, due 2026-04-14 — restore dry-run scheduled 2026-04-08 non-prod. Checklist link attached in tracker.

manu: DR-2026-04-01: DR-107 assigned to @manu, due 2026-04-20 — routing canary flow + cache warmup steps added.

oncall: DR-2026-04-01: DR-108 assigned to @oncall, due 2026-04-12 — telemetry rule updates + historical pattern analysis attached.

kevin: I'll coordinate with ops for quota exceptions and test IAM perms; adding as watcher on DR-107 and DR-106.

elaine: Great. A couple of follow-ups I want tracked explicitly in the thread (so we don't lose them in the tracker):
- recurring pattern: "slow failover detection" appears across 3 incidents — ask SRE to create a recurring evaluation every quarter.
- postgame: we need a debrief template that captures time-to-detect, time-to-restore, and cost impact estimate.

manu: Agreed on the debrief template. I'll draft one and add to runbooks/DR/templates.

zach: On backups: flagging cross-region transfer costs — I'll add a cost estimate to DR-105 so product can sign off on retention targets.

elaine: timeline check — can everyone confirm if their due dates are realistic? If something needs more time, update tracker ASAP.

sophie: dates OK for me.

oncall: telemetry needs a week for analysis + a week for rule rollout -> moving to 2026-04-19 if that's OK. Updating tracker.

kevin: ops support blocked until we get elevated read role in eu-prod — raising support ticket now.

elaine: thanks — marking that as blocker in tracker. We'll escalate if not resolved by EOD tomorrow.

incident-bot: Reminder scheduled: game-day dry-run 2026-04-08 09:00 UTC (non-prod). Participants: @sophie @manu @zach @oncall.

elaine: final ask — please add one short line under each tracker item describing the acceptance criteria (how we know it's done). Example: "DR-107 acceptance: automated canary succeeds 3 consecutive rollouts with <2% error and warmup cache hit rate >80%"

zach: adding acceptance criteria for DR-105 now.

manu: adding DR-107.

sophie: adding DR-106 with runbook steps and post-run verification checklist.

elaine: perfect. I'll run a brief sync before the next all-hands to review progress and escalate any blockers. Thanks everyone. :heart:
